company.name: Tremor
company.shortDescription: Tremor designs, builds & manages markets that utilize auction technologies and optimization techniques to improve price and cost efficiency.
company.description: Tremor is a venture-backed insurance technology firm where world class computer scientists, economists, market designers and industry practitioners are working together to build a modern risk transfer marketplace. Tremor's "smart market" platform incorporates intelligent market design, state-of-the-art auction technology and sophisticated optimization techniques to vastly improve how risk is transferred around the world.

productsAndServices.description: An online platform for pricing and placing reinsurance, enabling users to view market data and control risk pricing and allocation in real time.
productsAndServices.name: Panorama

productsAndServices.description: A digital solution to manage and finalize reinsurance contract negotiations and approvals, replacing manual document exchanges with a streamlined process.
productsAndServices.name: Tremor Wordings™

productsAndServices.description: An embedded communications platform within the Tremor marketplace that centralizes and streamlines communication between reinsurance market participants.
productsAndServices.name: TremorTalk™

productsAndServices.description: A tool to assist in closing gaps in reinsurance placements by identifying and engaging select markets to cover unpopular risks.
productsAndServices.name: Boost!™

productsAndServices.description: A platform division focused on providing transparency and market pricing for publicly funded residual insurance markets.
productsAndServices.name: Tremor Public™

productsAndServices.description: An online platform for issuing catastrophe bonds, accessible to investors, issuers, bankers, and brokers.
productsAndServices.name: Tremor Issuer™

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $2,750,000, or 14.67% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $9,972,861 to $38,453,674, a 3.86x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 61 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 66 (-3).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
